response.overview: Prasin, Voplatek, and Filip. three friends from Polevsko in the Šluknov salient, want to mark their final evening together with something special: stealing a crucifix and adding it to the collection of "trophies" in their hangout spot. But while two of them are preparing to head off to Prague, the third refuses to come to terms with the changes on the horizon. A satirical coming-of-age comedy about friendship, growing up, and the difficulty of letting others go.
response.title: Holy Moly!
